To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a comprehensive DSR evaluation framework and method is proposed that guides the DSR researcher in choosing the DSR evaluation strategies that are appropriate to the context of the DSR project and that the framework and method can be used to guide the selection of methodologies for evaluation.

1) DSR researchers can benefit from an extended DSR framework to help them design their evaluation activity; and 2) DSR evaluation design should consider the contextual factors of goals (e.g., the type and level desired rigor), conditions (e.g., type of artifact), and constraints (e.g., time, labor, and access to subjects) on the DSR researcher's ability to conduct evaluation.
“A framework and method is provided for choosing an evaluation strategy for Design Science Research, and for choosing appropriate evaluation methodologies within the selected evaluation strategy.”
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of the DSR research process, and the DSR evaluation framework is a key part of that.
how to design the evaluation of DSR, and we believe that this is a crucial step in the DSR research process.

the question: “How can the DSR evaluation process be designed and implemented in ways that are most appropriate for the DSR research goals, conditions, constraints, and the properties of the artifacts and theories being designed and evaluated?”
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed framework and method provide guidance on how to design the evaluation activity in DSR.
a DSR evaluation framework should be used to select a DSR evaluation strategy, which in turn would guide the choice of methodologies for the evaluation.
the DSR evaluation framework and method provide a systematic approach to choosing an appropriate evaluation strategy for a given DSR study.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the framework and method can be used to guide the DSR evaluation design activity by supporting the DSR researcher in making a choice of an appropriate evaluation strategy(ies) for the DSR research, and then in choosing appropriate methodologies for evaluation within the selected evaluation strategy(ies).

we have provided a framework for evaluation in DSR and have provided guidance to the DSR researcher on how to use this framework to select the most appropriate evaluation strategy for their particular DSR research project.
we have proposed an evaluation framework that provides DSR researchers with guidance on how to design the evaluation activity of their DSR project.
The main takeaway from our work is that
DSR researchers should consider a range of contextual factors when planning and designing an appropriate DSR evaluation.
the evaluation of DSR artifacts should not be considered in isolation from the design of the artifact, but should rather be designed as part of the overall DSR activity.

there is not a single “best” way of evaluating a DSR artifact and design theory, but a variety of strategies and methodologies are available, depending on the goals, conditions, constraints, and properties of the DSR artifact and its context.
